title: Workplace Cafe Management Program Tariff Annex on the Early Exit Charge
content:
Where a cafe management contract under the Workplace Cafe Management Program is brought to an end before the last day of its contracted term, an early exit charge falls due on it.

The months charged are the number of monthly management fees printed against the service model, and the exit fee base is the monthly management fee printed against that same service model. The exit charge before allowances is the months charged multiplied by the exit fee base, rounded to the nearest cent. No notice relief is given on that charge and no continuing outlet allowance is taken off it; the continuing outlet allowance is 0.00 per cent. The notice relief is taken off the exit charge before allowances first, and the continuing outlet allowance is then taken off the figure that step leaves; the result is rounded to the nearest cent and is never less than nil. The early exit charge is recorded against the billing period in which it is raised.

Quantities entering the result, and the record each is read from:

| Quantity | Read from |
|---|---|
| months charged | the number of monthly management fees printed against the service model held on the cafe management contract |
| exit fee base | the monthly management fee printed against that same service model |
| notice relief | nil |
| continuing outlet allowance | 0.00 per cent |
| billing period | the billing period in which the charge is raised |

Worked through on hypothetical inputs. Take a cafe management contract ended before the last day of its contracted term, held on a service model that prints 5 monthly management fees and a monthly management fee of 3120.00 USD. The months charged are 5 and the exit fee base is 3120.00 USD. The exit charge before allowances is 5 multiplied by 3120.00 USD, being 15600.00 USD rounded to the nearest cent. The notice relief is taken off that figure first: it is nil, leaving 15600.00 USD. The continuing outlet allowance is then taken off the figure that step leaves: at 0.00 per cent it is nil, leaving 15600.00 USD. Rounded to the nearest cent the result is 15600.00 USD, which is not less than nil, and it is recorded against the billing period in which the charge is raised.
